_: It.27: a FREE-follow custom follower that plugs into the vanilla follower system. The PAID-hireling path (PotentialHireling 0x0BCC9A) was REFUTED — its recruit INFOs are each hardcoded GetIsID==<a specific vanilla mercenary>, so a custom NPC fails them all at gold>=500 and the topic vanishes (probe: `modforge infodiag Skyrim.esm 0x0BCC84`). The path that WORKS for a custom NPC is the FREE 'Follow me, I need your help' topic (DialogueFavorGenericFollowBranchTopic, 0x0B0EE6), gated on PotentialFollowerFaction + a follower voice + GetRelationshipRank(player) >= 1 — and NOTABLY on PotentialHireling==0, so the two paths are mutually exclusive; she must NOT be in PotentialHireling. A static RELA to the player reads rank 0 at runtime, so the relationship is set by a tiny Papyrus quest script (MFHireFollowerSetup) at game start. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, wait a moment, talk to her, pick 'Follow me' — she joins for free and trails you (incl. across fast travel, per It.21). A separate PAID custom-topic example with its own result fragment is planned for It.28.

relationships._: Ally relationship to the player. parent = the follower; child = the Player NPC base (Skyrim.esm:0x000014 — NOT PlayerRef 0x000007, which is the placed ACHR; a RELA pointing at an ACHR is a type mismatch that CRASHES on load). A STATIC RELA reads rank 0 at runtime (gotchas.md), so this record alone does NOT surface the free topic — the MFHireFollowerSetup script is what actually sets the rank. Kept for documentation/intent.

npcs.name: Sera the Forged
npcs._greeting: Required so she is CONVERSABLE — a custom NPC with no custom dialogue isn't talkable just from being follower-eligible; the build gives her a host quest + Hello, and the vanilla 'Follow me' topic then surfaces on top.
npcs.greeting: Need a sword arm? I'm listening.
npcs._voiceType: FemaleEvenToned (0x013ADD) — MUST be a voice in VoicesFollowerNeutral (0x0D23AC) or the 'Follow me' topic's GetIsVoiceType condition fails and it never shows. FemaleNord/MaleNord are CITIZEN voices, NOT follower voices. Female follower voices: FemaleEvenToned 013ADD, FemaleSultry 013AE0, FemaleCondescending 013AE4, FemaleYoungEager 013ADC. Male: MaleEvenToned 013AD2, MaleYoungEager 013AD1, MaleEvenTonedAccented 0EA267.
npcs._factions: Whiterun crime/citizen factions (0x0267EA + 0x028172) for door/gate traversal; PotentialFollowerFaction (0x05C84D) — keyed by the free 'Follow me' dialogue. NOTE: PotentialHireling (0x0BCC9A) is deliberately OMITTED — the free-follow topic requires GetInFaction PotentialHireling==0, so adding it would DISABLE the working path (the two recruit paths are mutually exclusive).

quests._: Setup quest: StartGameEnabled so its OnInit() fires at game load; hosts the script that sets Sera's relationship rank to the player (which a static RELA can't do).
quests.name: ModForge Hire Setup

scripts._: Attach MFHireFollowerSetup (extends Quest) to the setup quest; SeraRef object property is bound to the placed follower ACHR (MF_HireFollowerRef). OnInit() runs SetRelationshipRank(player, 3). `package` compiles the .psc via Wine+PapyrusCompiler.

placements._: Sera in the Sleeping Giant Inn common room near the patrons (a no-package NPC at the cell origin 0,0,0 lands off-navmesh and is unreachable; actors snap to navmesh so any in-room coord works). editorId names the ACHR so the script property can bind to it; persistent=true so the ref resolves at game start even while the inn cell is unloaded.
